game_title: Off By One Fixer – Lantern Path Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Mystic Forest – Lantern Path, a lantern-lit path: the herbalist must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Lantern Path: a lantern-lit path
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Path, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round, a new dewdrops challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the fixes value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 300 points of dewdrops by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 300, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Off By One Fixer
